summary: Round 2 cleanly migrates both BotRepositoryTest and RawUpdateRepositoryTest off Reactor with assertion semantics preserved. No remaining un-migrated repository test files under the 5 affected packages. The TC7 grep-gate concern from round 1 remains an advisory tech-spec item, out of scope for this task's test code.

findings.issue: Advisory carry-over from round 1: TC7 grep gate still only inspects production sources, not test sources. Not a defect in this task's test files (both are correctly migrated); resolution would require a tech-spec edit (either strengthen TC7 grep to include backend/src/test, or require ./gradlew compileTestJava to pass post-Wave 2). Track as a tech-spec follow-up, not a Task 4 blocker.
findings.suggestion: In a separate tech-spec touch-up, extend TC7 grep to scan backend/src/test/java/com/botfunnel/{user,project,bot,events,webhook}/ as well, or add compileTestJava to the acceptance gate. No action required on the test files themselves.

semanticsCheck.findByProjectIdAndStatus_returnsConnecte: OK — Optional<Bot> return type inherently encodes exactly-one-or-empty; the assertNext+verifyComplete uniqueness property is preserved by the type signature itself. Field equality assertions on telegramBotId and status are retained.
semanticsCheck.findByProjectId_returnsAllStatusesForPro: OK — direct List<Bot> with hasSize(2) plus containsExactlyInAnyOrder on statuses and telegramBotIds is strictly equivalent to (and slightly stronger than) the original collectList+size check.
semanticsCheck.duplicateProjectIdUpdateId_throwsDuplica: OK — assertThatThrownBy(...).isInstanceOf(DuplicateKeyException.class) is the canonical AssertJ equivalent of expectError(DuplicateKeyException.class).verify(). First save() is synchronous, so it commits before the lambda runs; the duplicate-key path is reachable with correct sequencing. No ordering issue.
semanticsCheck.indexOps_tests: OK — sync MongoTemplate.indexOps(...).getIndexInfo() returns List<IndexInfo> directly; the .collectList().block() boundary is correctly dropped.

remainingRepoTestFiles: grep over backend/src/test/java/com/botfunnel/{user,project,bot,events,webhook}/ for ReactiveMongoRepository|ReactiveMongoTemplate|StepVerifier in *Repository* files returns zero matches. Only two repository test files exist under the affected packages; both migrated.
